<script>
		$(document).ready(function () {
			$('a.arrow, a.selected').click(function () {
				$('.filters .tabs').toggleClass('open');
				$('.customDropdown .arrow').toggleClass('noArrow');
			});
			$('a.selected.business').click(function () {
				$('.filters .tabs a').toggleClass('change1');
			});
			$('a.selected.franchise').click(function () {
				$('.filters .tabs a').toggleClass('change2');
			});
			$('a.selected.broker').click(function () {
				$('.filters .tabs a').toggleClass('change3');
			});
			$('a.franchiseSelect').click(function () {
				$('div.franchiseSprite').slideToggle();
			});
			$('.featuredBusSlider').slick({
				slidesToShow: 3,
				slidesToScroll: 3,
				arrows: true,
				autoplay: true,
				autoplaySpeed: 5000,
				responsive: [
					{
						breakpoint: 1024,
						settings: {
							slidesToShow: 2,
							slidesToScroll: 2
						}
					},
					{
						breakpoint: 642,
						settings: {
							slidesToShow: 1,
							slidesToScroll: 1
						}
					}
				]
			});
			$('.featFranSlider').slick({
				lazyload: 'ondemand',
				slidesToShow: 2,
				slidesToScroll: 2,
				arrows: true,
				autoplay: true,
				autoplaySpeed: 5000,
				responsive: [
					{
						breakpoint: 1024,
						settings: {
							slidesToShow: 1,
							slidesToScroll: 1
						}
					}
				]
			});
			$('.featFranSlider').on('afterChange', function (event, slick, currentSlide, nextSlide) {
				window.scrollBy(0, -1);
				window.scrollBy(0, 1);
			});
			$('.footerSlider').slick({
				fade: true,
				cssEase: 'linear',
				speed: 1200,
				arrows: false,
				dots: true,
				autoplay: true,
				autoplaySpeed: 12000,
				pauseOnHover: false
			});

			$('#ddlBrokerState').change(function () {
				if ($(this).val() != "" && $(this).val() != "CAN" && $(this).val() != "INT") {
					showbrokerlocations(true)
				}
				else {
					showbrokerlocations(false)
				}
            });

            if (window.location.href.indexOf("?afford-guidant") > -1) {
                $('#preQualify').foundation('reveal', 'open');
            }
		});


		function pageLoad() { // this gets fired when the UpdatePanel.Update() completes

			if ($('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "" &&
				$('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "CAN" &&
				$('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "INT") {
				showbrokerlocations(true)
			}
			else {
				showbrokerlocations(false)
			}
		};


		function showbrokerlocations(setting) {

			if (setting) {
				$("#ddlBrokerState").show();

				if ($('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "" &&
					$('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "CAN" &&
				$('#ddlBrokerState').val() != "INT") {
				$("#ddlBrokerCity").show();
			}
			else {
				$("#ddlBrokerCity").val(0);
				$("#ddlBrokerCity").hide();
			}
		}

		else {

			$("#ddlBrokerCity").val(0);
				$("#ddlBrokerCity").hide();
			}
			return
		};
	</script>
<script>
		$(window).load(function () {
			$('#ddlPriceMin').change(function () {
				var minValue = $('#ddlPriceMin').val();

				//Reset the Max values to all be allowed
				$('#ddlPriceMax option').removeAttr('disabled');

				if (minValue != '') {
					minValue = parseInt(minValue);

					$('#ddlPriceMax option').filter(function () {
						return $(this).val() != '' && parseInt($(this).val()) <= minValue;
					}).attr('disabled', 'disabled');

					//if the value we had chosen is now disabled select the first item (Any Max)
					if (!!$('#ddlPriceMax option:selected').attr('disabled')) {
						$('#ddlPriceMax').val('');
					}
				}
			});
		});
	</script>

<script>
        $(document).ready(function () {
            if ($("#ValidationSummaryFooter ul").length) {
                $('html, body').animate({
                    scrollTop: $("#newsletterFocus").offset().top
                }, 0);
            }

            $('.bfsLinkMobile').on('click', function () {
                $('.secondaryNavigation').slideToggle();
                $('.secondaryList.one, .secondaryList.two').hide();
                $('.withDrop').toggleClass('view');
                $('.secondaryTitle').removeClass('adjusted').show();
            });

            $('.secondaryTitle.one').on('click', function () {
                $('.secondaryList.one, .secondaryTitle.two, .secondaryTitle.three').slideToggle();
                $(this).toggleClass('adjusted');
            });

            $('.secondaryTitle.two').on('click', function () {
                $('.secondaryList.two, .secondaryTitle.one, .secondaryTitle.three, .myAccount, .bfsLinkMobile').slideToggle();
                $(this).toggleClass('adjusted');
            });

            checkSize();
        });

        function checkSize() {
            var offset = 60;

            if ($(".mobileHead").css("float") == "none") {
                $(window).scroll(function () {
                    if ($(this).scrollTop() > offset) {
                        $(".header").addClass("topSticky");
                    } else {
                        $(".header").removeClass("topSticky");
                    }
                });

            }
        };
    </script>
